## 1. ABOUT THE COMPANY

**Nairobi Forensics LLP** is a leading forensic and financial investigation firm based in Kenya, providing independent forensic accounting, financial investigation, tax forensic services, litigation support, and business advisory services to organisations, legal professionals, financial institutions, and government entities.

**Core Services:**
- Forensic Accounting & Financial Investigations
- Tax Investigations & Forensic Tax Services
- Financial Crime & Complex Investigations
- Asset Tracing & Recovery Support
- Litigation, Disputes & Expert Services
- Corporate Investigations, Valuation & Due Diligence
- Business Recovery & Insolvency

**Contact Information:**
- Website: https://nairobi-forensics.vercel.app
- Contact Page: https://nairobi-forensics.vercel.app/contact
- Email: [info@nairobi-forensics.com]
